messages:
leo: Starting RC staged publish for py/ts SDK. Window 23:30 UTC. Objective: rotate dist-tags safely, publish rc wheels, and add deprecation timeline for sync client (v2.x).

maya: Thanks. I'll trigger smoke + canary runner on dedicated nodes. Target metrics: error rate <= 0.4%, median latency <= 10% of baseline.

ollie: For npm plan: publish as @redwood/sdk@2.1.0-rc.1, add dist-tag `next-rc`, observe for 45m, then promote to `next`, then 1h observation before `stable`. For pip we'll upload with `2.1.0rc1` and mark release notes accordingly.

leo: deploy-bot: run publish job py-ts-rc-staged (job_id=3429876590)

deploy-bot: job queued: py-ts-rc-staged (id: 3429876590)

jamie: CI flagged a missing METADATA:License entry in wheel yesterday. I pushed a CI lint fix in #ci/packaging. @ollie please confirm wheel metadata before publishing.

ollie: Confirmed: wheel metadata present. Command I used: `python -m build && twine check dist/*`

maya: Can you publish sha256 after upload? I'll cross-check on the canary hosts.

ollie: Uploaded to staging. sha256: `b8c1a7f2d6e9e4a7c9f2...`

deploy-bot: publish succeeded: py-ts-rc-staged (id: 3429876590)

maya: Canary run started on three dedicated nodes. Reporting back in 15m.

leo: Important: we'll also tag old v1.x as `legacy-v1` on npm and note pip yanks if we need to prevent accidental installs. Keep rollback commands handy: 
- `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.9.7 legacy-v1`
- `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk stable`
- `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@<previous> stable`
- PyPI yank: `twine remove` (follow up with support ticket)

jamie: Added a short rollback play in the release doc. Also included a support template for customer-facing deprecation emails.

maya: First canary pass: basic smoke and auth flows good. One minor warning on long-polling tests but below threshold.

ollie: Noted. I'll hold promotion to `next` for now and re-run the batch tests focused on streaming and reconnect behavior. ETA 20m.

leo: Decision: if streaming p99 increases > 15% we abort promotion. Also watch Prometheus alert rule `client_error_rate > 0.5% over 5m`.

maya: Re-run finished. Streaming p99 delta = +6%, error rate steady. Ready to promote to `next`.

deploy-bot: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.1.0-rc.1 next (triggered by leo)

ollie: Promoted to `next`. Starting 1h observation window. Artifacts in: `gs://redwood-releases/rc/3429876543/` (wheels, tarballs, sha256, manifest).

jamie: Draft of release notes posted in the docs repo. Key items: signer rotation steps, sync client deprecation timeline (deprecated -> 30 days -> removed in 90 days), upgrade guide for async client.

leo: Reminder: update quickstart snippets in docs and js/py examples before `stable` flip. I'll sync with content ops for the announcement wording.

maya: Monitoring: no errors above threshold so far. Will continue to monitor logs and traces. Posting updates every 15m.

jamie: Creating the customer email draft now. Will include migration snippet: `from redwood import AsyncClient` and link to migration guide.

leo: If anything spikes react with :rotating_light: and tag @oncall. Otherwise we'll flip to `stable` after observation window.

maya: 45m checkpoint: all green. No backing off.

ollie: Preparing final publish to npm `stable`. Plan: promote 2.1.0-rc.1 -> 2.1.0 stable after CI signature verification. Command: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.1.0 stable`

deploy-bot: signature-verify job started (id=3429876605)

deploy-bot: signature-verify passed (id=3429876605)

leo: Promoting to stable now. After flip I'll post the changelog + deprecation banner.

deploy-bot: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.1.0 stable (triggered by leo)

maya: Promotion complete. Posting announcement in #general after docs merge.

jamie: Pushed deprecation banner to docs site and included a beta badge for `next` docs pages. Created support ticket template for yanked wheels if rollback needed.

ollie: Final note: keep `legacy-v1` dist-tag in npm for 60 days, then evaluate retention policy.

leo: Thanks team. Closing the window. I'll file a short postmortem if any follow-ups pop up.
